code_changes.guarded_issue_conclusion_wrapper: scripts/issues/apply_issue_conclusion_with_pre_gate.py now accepts --item-index so one shared multi-item conclusion manifest can be applied per target through repeated family-owned guarded wrapper invocations instead of reopening raw apply entrypoints.

notes: The representative guarded live sample keeps one shared pre-gate decision and one shared remediation-owned issue-conclusion manifest for the whole batch, but executes live mutation per target through repeated wrapper calls with explicit item indexes 0, 1, and 2.
All three items remained on the issue-conclusion family path; no mixed remediation families were absorbed into the same live apply pass.
Each guarded apply ran with context-mode preserve-existing and reported allowed-via-targeted-conclusion-remediation while updating already-closed issues in place.
